rules.title: Payment terms no longer than 30 days
rules.rationale: House position is payment within 30 days of invoice. Anything longer needs finance approval.

rules.title: Liability must be capped
rules.rationale: Liability must be capped at the fees paid in the preceding twelve months. Uncapped liability is not acceptable.
rules.preferredWording: liability capped at the fees paid in the preceding twelve months

rules.title: No automatic renewal without notice
rules.rationale: Automatic renewal is acceptable only with at least 60 days' notice of non-renewal.

rules.title: Governing law within the EU
rules.rationale: Governing law must be an EU member state. Flag any other jurisdiction for legal review.

rules.title: Customer retains its background IP
rules.rationale: Background intellectual property stays with its owner; only foreground deliverables may be assigned.
